title: Flightradar24 Flight Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: ADS-B aircraft snapshots (`adsb:aircraft`), personal flight logbook (`flight:log`), commute trips (`commute:trip`), transit arrivals (`transit:arrival`), geofence events (`geofence:event`), travel documents (`travel:document`), fare quotes (`airprice:quote`).
app: Home ADS-B receiver (dump1090/readsb/tar1090 JSON feed), personal flight logbook exports, commute/transit APIs, and phone geofence webhooks via Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightradar24:flight
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by callsign
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Flightradar24 flight data has stopped arriving for a given callsign.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per callsign and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It combines when one part of your Flightradar24 flight feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
